name: Capability revocation architecture
source_description: Curated seed for capability revocation feature work.

body.summary: Capability revocation work starts in kernel delegation and revocation stores, checks core capability token and grant semantics, and validates behavior through revocation-oracle plus kernel/core tests.
constraints: Treat revocation as part of capability validation and receipt evidence, not an isolated product feature.
Prefer revocation-oracle tests before broad semantic test matches when the query includes revocation.
Do not infer release truth from Graphiti memory.
